verdicts.reason: A uses a left-to-right banner layout that fits the format, but the headline is jammed against the right column: the period in 'sunshine.' nearly touches the CTA, and the 'Solstice…' copy breaks into four ragged centred lines ending in the orphan 'flavours.' B is a clean but mostly shrunk copy of the original stack, with tight top and bottom margins, wide empty sides and supporting copy too small to read comfortably. Even so, it keeps the hierarchy and spacing more orderly and has no near-collision.
